summary: Based on weakened EBITDA and elevated debt, the Total Net Leverage and Senior Secured Net Leverage covenants should be tightened. Liquidity remains ample, so the minimum liquidity covenant is unchanged. Reporting, compliance, and notice provisions show no deterioration and are retained. No new protections are warranted.
